SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.order_state AS orderState, o.vehicle_vin AS vehicleVin, o.row_version AS rowVersion, o.create_time AS createTime FROM vso_order o WHERE o.row_valid = 1 AND (o.vehicle_vin = #{vin} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vso_delivery_record r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id AND r.row_valid = 1 AND r.vehicle_vin = #{vin})) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vso_order_party p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.user_id = #{accountId} AND p.row_valid = 1 AND p.party_role IN
#{role} ) ORDER BY o.create_time, o.order_id LIMIT #{limit}
